workspaceHelp: Review opportunities, prepare bids, and manage organizational readiness in one focused workspace.
signInHelp: Continue with Google, or get a one-time code by e-mail.
privacyNote: Google sign-in is handled by Google; e-mail codes expire in 10 minutes and work once. Plasma only uses the account details required for access control.
redirecting: Your workspace is ready. Redirecting to dashboard…
pendingHelp: Your company profile has been submitted and is waiting for review. You do not need to submit the form again.
approvedHelp: Once approved, you will get access to Tender Explorer, compliance analysis, and reports.
nextReview: What happens next: Plasma reviews your company profile.
nextSignin: If your access changes, sign in again so your browser receives current authority.
help: Need help? Contact Plasma support through your pilot coordinator.
refreshFailed: Approval status could not be refreshed. Please try again.
blockedHelp: Contact Plasma support if you believe this is a mistake.

invite.title: Join {organization}
invite.bodyNoInviter: You were invited to join as {role}.
invite.emailHint: Sign in as {email}, with Google or an e-mail code. Other addresses, even on the same domain, are not accepted.
invite.signIn: Sign in with Google to accept
invite.notFound: This invitation link is not valid. It may have been replaced by a newer link.

states.EXPIRED: This invitation has expired. Ask the person who invited you to resend it.

errors.emailMismatch: You are signed in with a different e-mail address. Sign out and sign in with the invited address.
errors.notApproved: This organization is not approved yet. You will be able to join once it is.
errors.failed: The invitation could not be accepted. Try again.

invite.signedInNotFound: You are signed in. If this invitation was for this address, you have joined: open your workspace.

configuration.title: Sign-in is temporarily unavailable
configuration.body: We could not complete your sign-in with Google. Plasma's sign-in service is being updated or is briefly unavailable. Your account and your data are safe.
configuration.hint: Please try again in a few minutes. If it keeps happening, contact your Plasma administrator and mention the error code below.

accessDenied.title: This account cannot sign in
accessDenied.body: The Google account you chose could not be used to sign in to Plasma.
accessDenied.hint: Choose an account with a verified e-mail address, or ask your Plasma administrator for access.

verification.title: This sign-in link is no longer valid
verification.body: The link may have expired or may already have been used.
verification.hint: Start the sign-in again from the sign-in page.

default.title: Something went wrong while signing in
default.body: Your sign-in could not be completed.
default.hint: Please try again. If it keeps happening, contact your Plasma administrator and mention the error code below.

emailCode.emailHelp: We will e-mail you a 6-digit code. No password needed.
emailCode.codeHelp: The code expires in 10 minutes and works once. Check your spam folder if it does not arrive.

errors.invalid_code: That code is not right. Check it and try again.
errors.code_expired: This code has expired or was used up. Send a new code.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a little, then try again.
errors.account_unavailable: This account cannot sign in with an e-mail code. Use Google, or contact Plasma support.
errors.unavailable: Sign-in is briefly unavailable. Try again in a moment.

explore.title: You are exploring Plasma
explore.lead: Browse open opportunities and walk through a demo analysis. Uploading your own tender documents, analysing them and the award ledger come with a pilot.
explore.ctaTitle: Start a pilot with your own tenders
explore.pilotIncludesUpload: Upload your own TOR or RFP (PDF or DOCX)
explore.pilotIncludesAnalysis: Requirements, evidence gaps, team shortlist and an EOI draft from your records
explore.pilotIncludesLedger: Award ledger: who won comparable contracts
explore.messageHelp: For example the tenders you are preparing or a good time to call.
explore.pilotRequested: Thank you: the Plasma team has your pilot request.
explore.callRequested: Thank you: the Plasma team will contact you to schedule a call.
explore.requestedHelp: We reply by e-mail to the address you signed in with.
explore.requestFailed: Your request could not be sent. Try again.
explore.opportunitiesHelp: The nearest deadlines across the sources Plasma reads. Each links to its official notice.
explore.demoHelp: A real public notice analysed for {firm}, a fictional firm: every reference and expert below is invented.

stepHelp.requirements: Every shortlisting requirement extracted from the notice, checked against the firm's own references and experts.
stepHelp.gaps: What the firm cannot prove yet, and what would close each gap.
stepHelp.team: Experts from the firm's library ranked against the assignment.
stepHelp.eoi: The start of the Expression of Interest drafted from the firm's records, for the team to review.
